primary_selection: Require current explicit compensation evidence or an objectively computable reward.
Require a current buyer-controlled trigger or deadline that makes the next step timely.
Require a valid external action channel that can return a verifiable receipt.
exclude_from_primary_race: Non-cash task rewards or subscription credits.
Referral or affiliate qualification enquiries without a live referred buyer, current conversion event, or already-earned commission.
Generic roles with no current compensated trial evidence.
Destinations with a known permanent delivery failure.
Gmail threads missing any of BOSS_IDENTITY_CLEAN_TRUE, BOSS_BUSINESS_ACTION_ELIGIBLE_TRUE, BOSS_IDENTITY_SCOPE_THREAD_ONLY.
Any Gmail thread carrying BOSS_WRITE_SAFETY_BLOCKED_CURRENT, BOSS_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED, BOSS_IDENTITY_CONTAMINATED or BOSS_PERM_BOUNCE.
Bounties whose advertised amount is not backed by current platform/maintainer funding evidence, or whose payout rail requires new spend before earning.
offer_and_cta: Prefer bounded deliverables with acceptance checks and a defined delivery window.
Ask for the exact compensated scope, acceptance criteria and payment route when any are still missing.
For warm leads, use a new factual trigger and keep the unpaid proof smaller than the paid core.
Do not send another follow-up to the same warm thread on the same day without a new human reply or a materially new buyer-controlled trigger.

conversion_rescue.stop_condition: Do not add generic first-touch volume while HUMAN_REPLY, SCOPE_LOCKED, PAYMENT_READY and COMPLETED remain weak and a valid near-cash pool exists.

requirements: The action channel is writable now.
No spend, identity, KYC, credential or safety fact is invented.

switch_rule: If six delivered high-confidence actions produce zero buyer-controlled compensated next steps, change source or offer before sending another six.
invariants: Keep existing P0 and S++ quality gates.
Do not count a reply, interview, invitation, invoice, credit, voucher or payment notice as settled revenue.
Do not add paid tools, paid memberships or new KYC.
Only real external buyer/platform actions count as money work; configuration, research, scans and self-tests count as zero.
Never clear or overwrite identity/safety labels merely to make an opportunity count.
